title: Not our favorite
text: Not our favorite. We prefer a cake brownie and even though following the cake type recipe it came out too soft.  Our favorite was Double Chocolate brownies but we've been unable to find any. Hope they are not discontinued. We have one more box of these to try so I'll tweek it to try and make it more palatable.
